H5851.name: Atarah
H5851.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H5851.brief: Wife of Jerahmeel; mother of Onam
H5851.short: Atarah was the wife of Jerahmeel and the mother of Onam, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah (<ref="1Ch.2.26">1Ch.2.26</ref>).

H5832G.name: Azarel
H5832G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5832G.brief: One of the Danite warriors who joined David at Ziklag
H5832G.short: Azarel was one of the Danite warriors who joined David at Ziklag (<ref="1Ch.12.6">1Ch.12.6</ref>).

H5832H.name: Azarel
H5832H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5832H.brief: Leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh under David
H5832H.short: Azarel son of Jeroham was the leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during David's reign (<ref="1Ch.27.22">1Ch.27.22</ref>).

H5832I.name: Azarel
H5832I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5832I.brief: One of those who married foreign women during Ezra's time
H5832I.short: Azarel was among those who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra (<ref="Ezr.10.41">Ezr.10.41</ref>).

H5832J.name: Azarel
H5832J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5832J.brief: Priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall
H5832J.short: Azarel was a priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time (<ref="Neh.12.36">Neh.12.36</ref>).

H5838J.name: Azariah
H5838J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5838J.brief: Descendant of Jerahmeel, son of Hezron
H5838J.short: Azariah was a descendant of Jerahmeel, the son of Hezron, from the tribe of Judah (<ref="1Ch.2.38, 39">1Ch.2.38, 39</ref>).

H5838I.name: Azariah
H5838I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5838I.brief: Son of Ethan, descendant of Judah
H5838I.short: Azariah was the son of Ethan, a descendant of Judah (<ref="1Ch.2.8">1Ch.2.8</ref>).

H5838L.name: Azariah
H5838L.desc: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5838L.brief: Grandfather of Ezra, descended from High Priests
H5838L.short: Azariah was father of Seraiah, father of Ezra. His ancestors served as high priests (<ref="1Ch.6.13, 14; 9:11; Ezr.7.1">1Ch.6.13, 14; 9:11; Ezr.7.1</ref>).

H5838K.name: Azariah
H5838K.desc: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5838K.brief: Descendant of Zadok, a priest before Solomon's reign
H5838K.short: Azariah, the descendant of Zadok, was a priest before the reign of King Solomon (<ref="1Ki.4.2; 1Ch.6.9">1Ki.4.2; 1Ch.6.9</ref>).

H5838G.name: Azariah
H5838G.desc: Priest living at the time of United Monarchy
H5838G.brief: High priest during Solomon's reign, descendant of Zadok
H5838G.short: Azariah, the descendant of Zadok, served as high priest during the reign of King Solomon (<ref="1Ch.6.10, 11; Ezr.7.3">1Ch.6.10, 11; Ezr.7.3</ref>).

H5838H.name: Azariah
H5838H.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H5838H.brief: Son of Nathan, an official in Solomon's court
H5838H.short: Azariah, the son of Nathan, was an official in King Solomon's court (<ref="1Ki.4.5">1Ki.4.5</ref>).

H5838M.name: Azariah
H5838M.desc: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5838M.brief: Prophet who encouraged King Asa to seek God
H5838M.short: Azariah, the son of Oded, was a prophet who encouraged King Asa of Judah to seek God (<ref="2Ch.15.1">2Ch.15.1</ref>).

H5838Q.name: Azariah
H5838Q.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5838Q.brief: Son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah
H5838Q.short: Azariah was one of the sons of King Jehoshaphat of Judah (<ref="2Ch.21.2">2Ch.21.2</ref>).

H5838S.name: Azariah
H5838S.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5838S.brief: A commander who helped crown Joash king
H5838S.short: Azariah son of Jeroham was a military commander who supported Jehoiada in restoring Joash to the throne of Judah.

H5838T.name: Azariah
H5838T.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5838T.brief: A commander who supported Joash's coronation
H5838T.short: Azariah son of Obed was one of the commanders who supported Jehoiada in making Joash king.

H5838N.name: Azariah
H5838N.desc: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5838N.brief: High priest who confronted King Uzziah
H5838N.short: Azariah, the high priest, confronted King Uzziah when he attempted to burn incense in the temple (<ref="2Ch.26.17 , 20">2Ch.26.17, 20</ref>).

H5838O.name: Azariah
H5838O.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5838O.brief: Leader who opposed the enslaving of captives
H5838O.short: Azariah, along with other leaders, opposed the enslaving of captives from Judah during the reign of King Ahaz (<ref="2Ch.28.12">2Ch.28.12</ref>).

H5838U.name: Azariah
H5838U.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5838U.brief: A Levite who helped purify the temple
H5838U.short: Azariah son of Jehallel was a Merarite Levite who helped purify the temple under King Hezekiah.

H5838V.name: Azariah
H5838V.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5838V.brief: A Levite who helped purify the temple
H5838V.short: Azariah son of Jehallelel was a Kohathite Levite who helped purify the temple under King Hezekiah.

H5838P.name: Azariah
H5838P.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5838P.short: Azariah, the chief priest from the family of Zadok, served during the reign of King Hezekiah (<ref="2Ch.31.10, 13">2Ch.31.10, 13</ref>).

H5838Z.name: Azariah
H5838Z.desc: Daniel's compatriot living at the time of Exile and Return
H5838Z.brief: One of Daniel's companions, survived the fiery furnace
H5838Z.short: Azariah, also known as Abednego, was one of Daniel's companions who survived the fiery furnace (<ref="Dan.1.6, 7, 11, 19; 2:17, 49; 3">Dan.1.6, 7, 11, 19; 2:17, 49; 3</ref>).

H5838W.name: Azariah
H5838W.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5838W.brief: Son of Maaseiah, repairer of Jerusalem's wall
H5838W.short: Azariah, son of Maaseiah, repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near his house during Nehemiah's time (<ref="Neh.3.23, 24">Neh.3.23, 24</ref>).

H5838X.name: Azariah
H5838X.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5838X.brief: Priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall
H5838X.short: Azariah was a priest who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time (<ref="Neh.7.7; 10:2; 12:33">Neh.7.7; 10:2; 12:33</ref>).

H5838Y.name: Azariah
H5838Y.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5838Y.brief: Levite who helped the people understand the Law
H5838Y.short: Azariah was a Levite who helped the people understand the Law during the time of Ezra (<ref="Neh.8.7">Neh.8.7</ref>).

H5838R.name: Azariahu
H5838R.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5838R.brief: Son of King Jehoshaphat of Judah
H5838R.short: Azariahu was one of the sons of King Jehoshaphat of Judah (<ref="2Ch.21.2">2Ch.21.2</ref>).

H5811.name: Azaz
H5811.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5811.brief: Descendant of Reuben; father of Bela
H5811.short: Azaz, a descendant of Reuben, was the father of Bela (<ref="1Ch.5.8">1Ch.5.8</ref>).

H5812G.name: Azaziah
H5812G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5812G.short: Azaziah was a Levite musician who played the harp during the reign of King David (<ref="1Ch.15.21">1Ch.15.21</ref>).

H5812H.name: Azaziah
H5812H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5812H.brief: Leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh under David
H5812H.short: Azaziah was the leader of the half-tribe of Manasseh during the reign of King David (<ref="1Ch.27.20">1Ch.27.20</ref>).

H5812I.name: Azaziah
H5812I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5812I.brief: Levite during Hezekiah's reign, in charge of offerings
H5812I.short: Azaziah was a Levite during the reign of King Hezekiah, appointed to oversee the freewill offerings (<ref="2Ch.31.13">2Ch.31.13</ref>).

H5802.name: Azbuk
H5802.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5802.brief: Father of Nehemiah, who repaired part of Jerusalem's wall
H5802.short: Azbuk was the father of Nehemiah, who repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall near the tombs of David (<ref="Neh.3.16">Neh.3.16</ref>).

H5803G.name: Azgad
H5803G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5803G.brief: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem
H5803G.short: Azgad was the ancestor of 1,222 (or 2,322) exiles who returned to Jerusalem (<ref="Ezr.2.12; 8:12; Neh.7.17">Ezr.2.12; 8:12; Neh.7.17</ref>).

H5803H.name: Azgad
H5803H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5803H.brief: Leader who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time
H5803H.short: Azgad was one of the leaders who sealed the covenant during the time of Nehemiah (<ref="Neh.10.15">Neh.10.15</ref>).

H5819.name: Aziza
H5819.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5819.brief: Descendant of Zattu, had married a foreign woman
H5819.short: Aziza, a descendant of Zattu, was one of the men who had married foreign women during the time of Ezra (<ref="Ezr.10.27">Ezr.10.27</ref>).

H5820I.name: Azmaveth
H5820I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5820I.brief: Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
H5820I.short: Azmaveth, a Benjamite warrior, was one of the men who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from Saul (<ref="1Ch.12.3">1Ch.12.3</ref>).

H5820J.name: Azmaveth
H5820J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5820J.brief: Overseer of royal treasuries under King David
H5820J.short: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of King David's treasuries (<ref="1Ch.27.25">1Ch.27.25</ref>).

H5820H.name: Azmaveth
H5820H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5820H.brief: Descendant of Saul, son of Jehoaddah
H5820H.short: Azmaveth, a descendant of Saul, son of Jehoaddah..

H5820G.name: Azmaveth
H5820G.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H5820G.brief: One of David's mighty men, a Barhumite
H5820G.short: Azmaveth the Barhumite was one of David's mighty men, known for his valor (<ref="2Sa.23.31; 1Ch.11.33">2Sa.23.31; 1Ch.11.33</ref>).

H5837H.name: Azriel
H5837H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5837H.brief: Ruler of the tribe of Naphtali under David
H5837H.short: Azriel son of Jeremoth was the ruler of the tribe of Naphtali during the reign of King David (<ref="1Ch.27.19">1Ch.27.19</ref>).

H5837G.name: Azriel
H5837G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5837G.brief: Head of a half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead
H5837G.short: Azriel was a head of a father's house in the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead (<ref="1Ch.5.24">1Ch.5.24</ref>).

H5837I.name: Azriel
H5837I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5837I.brief: Official sent to arrest the prophet Jeremiah
H5837I.short: Azriel was one of the officials sent by King Jehoiakim to arrest the prophet Jeremiah (<ref="Jer.36.26">Jer.36.26</ref>).

H5840G.name: Azrikam
H5840G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5840G.brief: A descendant of David through Jehoiachin.
H5840G.short: Azrikam was a descendant of David through Jehoiachin.

H5840H.name: Azrikam
H5840H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5840H.brief: A descendant of Saul and Jonathan.
H5840H.short: Azrikam was a descendant of Saul and Jonathan.

H5840I.name: Azrikam
H5840I.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H5840I.short: Azrikam was a Levite who lived in Jerusalem.

H5840J.name: Azrikam
H5840J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5840J.brief: An official in King Ahaz's household.
H5840J.short: Azrikam was an official in charge of King Ahaz's palace.

H5806H.name: Azubah
H5806H.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5806H.brief: Wife of Caleb and mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
H5806H.short: Azubah was Caleb's wife and the mother of his sons Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

H5806G.name: Azubah
H5806G.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5806G.brief: The mother of King Jehoshaphat of Judah.
H5806G.short: Azubah was the mother of King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

H5821.name: Azzan
H5821.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5821.brief: Father of Paltiel, a leader from the tribe of Issachar.
H5821.short: Azzan was the father of Paltiel, a leader from Issachar chosen to help divide Canaan.

H5809I.name: Azzur
H5809I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5809I.brief: Father of the wicked prince Jaazaniah.
H5809I.short: Azzur was the father of Jaazaniah, one of the wicked princes Ezekiel saw in a vision.

H5809H.name: Azzur
H5809H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5809H.brief: Father of the false prophet Hananiah.
H5809H.short: Azzur was the father of Hananiah, a false prophet who opposed Jeremiah.

H5809G.name: Azzur
H5809G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5809G.brief: A leader who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.
H5809G.short: Azzur was one of the leaders who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.

H5858B.name: Ebal
H5858B.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5858B.brief: Son of Shobal and descendant of Seir the Horite
H5858B.short: Ebal was a son of Shobal and a descendant of Seir the Horite, mentioned in the genealogies of Esau's family.

H5867H.name: Elam
H5867H.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5867H.brief: A temple gatekeeper during David's reign
H5867H.short: Elam was a temple gatekeeper during the reign of King David.

H5867G.name: Elam
H5867G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5867G.short: Elam was a son of Shashak, from the tribe of Benjamin.

H5867B.name: Elam
H5867B.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5867B.brief: Ancestor of exiles who returned to Jerusalem
H5867B.short: Elam was the ancestor of a group of exiles who returned to Jerusalem.

H5867C.name: Elam
H5867C.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5867C.brief: Son of Shem, grandson of Noah
H5867C.short: Elam was a son of Shem and grandson of Noah.

H5867I.name: Elam
H5867I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5867I.brief: A leader who signed Nehemiah's covenant
H5867I.short: Elam was a leader who signed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H5867J.name: Elam
H5867J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5867J.brief: A priest or Levite in Nehemiah's time
H5867J.short: Elam was a priest or Levite during the time of Nehemiah.

H5881.name: Enan
H5881.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5881.brief: Father of Ahira, a leader of the tribe of Naphtali.
H5881.short: Enan was the father of Ahira, the leader of the tribe of Naphtali during the wilderness journey.

H5891H.name: Ephah
H5891H.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5891H.brief: Caleb's concubine and mother of three sons.
H5891H.short: Ephah was a concubine of Caleb who bore him three sons: Haran, Moza, and Gazez.

H5891I.name: Ephah
H5891I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5891I.brief: Son of Jahdai, in Caleb's genealogy.
H5891I.short: Ephah was one of the sons of Jahdai, mentioned in the genealogy of Caleb.

H5891G.name: Ephah
H5891G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5891G.brief: Son of Midian and grandson of Abraham.
H5891G.short: Ephah was one of the sons of Midian, who was a son of Abraham through Keturah.

H5829H.name: Ezer
H5829H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5829H.brief: Gadite warrior; joined David at Ziklag.
H5829H.short: Ezer was a Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from King Saul.

H5829G.name: Ezer
H5829G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5829G.brief: Father or founder of Hushah, of Ephrathah.
H5829G.short: Ezer was the father or founder of Hushah and a son of Hur of Ephrathah.

H5829K.name: Ezer
H5829K.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5829K.brief: Son of Ephraim; killed by the men of Gath.
H5829K.short: Ezer was a son of Ephraim who was killed by the men of Gath while attempting to steal their livestock.

H5827.name: Ezer
H5827.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5827.brief: Levite; participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.
H5827.short: Ezer was a Levite who participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall during the time of Nehemiah.

H5829I.name: Ezer
H5829I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5829I.brief: Ruler of Mizpah; repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall.
H5829I.short: Ezer, the ruler of Mizpah, repaired another section of Jerusalem's wall near the armory.

H5830G.name: Ezra
H5830G.desc: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
H5830G.brief: Priest; scribe; led a group of exiles back to Jerusalem.
H5830G.short: Ezra was a priest and scribe who led a group of Jewish exiles back to Jerusalem and played a key role in the spiritual reformation of the people.

H5830H.name: Ezra
H5830H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5830H.brief: Priest; returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel; participated in wall dedication.
H5830H.short: Ezra was a priest who returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel and participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

H5834.name: Ezrah
H5834.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5834.brief: Son of Chelub; mentioned in Judah's genealogy.
H5834.short: Ezrah was a son of Chelub, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H5836.name: Ezri
H5836.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5836.short: Ezri was the overseer of King David's agricultural workers who tilled the soil.

H5893G.name: Ir
H5893G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H5893G.brief: Son of Bela, descendant of Benjamin.
H5893G.short: Ir was a son of Bela and descendant of Benjamin.

H5896G.name: Ira
H5896G.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H5896G.short: Ira the Jairite was a priest under King David.

H5896H.name: Ira
H5896H.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H5896H.brief: One of David's Thirty warriors, from Tekoa.
H5896H.short: Ira the Tekoite was one of King David's Thirty mighty warriors.

H5896I.name: Ira
H5896I.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H5896I.brief: One of David's Thirty warriors, an Ithrite.
H5896I.short: Ira the Ithrite was one of King David's Thirty mighty warriors.

H5897.name: Irad
H5897.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H5897.brief: Descendant of Cain; father of Mehujael.
H5897.short: Irad was a descendant of Cain and the father of Mehujael.

H5813G.name: Uzzi
H5813G.desc: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5813G.brief: High priest in the line of Eleazar
H5813G.short: Uzzi was a high priest in the lineage of Eleazar, son of Aaron.

H5813H.name: Uzzi
H5813H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5813H.brief: Son of Tola, grandson of Issachar
H5813H.short: Uzzi, a grandson of Issachar, was one of the sons of Tola.

H5813I.name: Uzzi
H5813I.desc: Warrior living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5813I.brief: Son of Bela, grandson of Benjamin
H5813I.short: Uzzi, a grandson of Benjamin, was one of the sons of Bela.

H5813J.name: Uzzi
H5813J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5813J.short: Uzzi, a Benjamite, was one of the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

H5813K.name: Uzzi
H5813K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5813K.short: Uzzi, a Levite, was an overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem.

H5813L.name: Uzzi
H5813L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5813L.brief: Priestly leader in the days of Joiakim
H5813L.short: Uzzi was a leader of the priestly family of Jedaiah during Joiakim's time.

H5813M.name: Uzzi
H5813M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5813M.brief: Priest at the dedication of Jerusalem's wall
H5813M.short: Uzzi, a priest, participated in the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.

H5814.name: Uzzia
H5814.desc: Warrior living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5814.brief: Ashterathite, one of David's mighty warriors
H5814.short: Uzzia the Ashterathite was one of David's mighty warriors.

H5818I.name: Uzziah
H5818I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5818I.short: Uzziah was in charge of King David's storehouses.

H5818H.name: Uzziah
H5818H.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5818H.brief: Levite musician in the time of David
H5818H.short: Uzziah (Azariah) was a Levite musician during David's reign.

H5818G.name: Uzziah
H5818G.desc: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5818G.short: Uzziah (Azariah) was king of Judah, known for his long and prosperous reign.

H5818J.name: Uzziah
H5818J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5818J.brief: Israelite who married a foreign wife
H5818J.short: Uzziah was an Israelite who had married a foreign wife during the Exile.

H5818K.name: Uzziah
H5818K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5818K.brief: Judahite who resettled in Jerusalem after the exile
H5818K.short: Uzziah, a descendant of Judah, resettled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H5816J.name: Uzziel
H5816J.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5816J.brief: Levite musician in the time of David
H5816J.short: Uzziel (Azarel), a Levite musician, served during David's reign.

H5816H.name: Uzziel
H5816H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5816H.brief: Simeonite leader who attacked the Amalekites
H5816H.short: Uzziel, a Simeonite leader, joined in an attack against the Amalekites.

H5816I.name: Uzziel
H5816I.desc: Warrior living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5816I.brief: Son of Bela, grandson of Benjamin
H5816I.short: Uzziel, a grandson of Benjamin, was one of the sons of Bela.

H5816K.name: Uzziel
H5816K.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H5816K.brief: Levite who helped cleanse the temple under Hezekiah
H5816K.short: Uzziel, a Levite, assisted in cleansing the temple during Hezekiah's reign.

H5816G.name: Uzziel
H5816G.desc: Aaron's uncle living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H5816G.brief: Son of Kohath, uncle of Moses and Aaron
H5816G.short: Uzziel, son of Kohath, was an uncle of Moses and Aaron.

H5816L.name: Uzziel
H5816L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H5816L.brief: Goldsmith who helped repair Jerusalem's wall
H5816L.short: Uzziel, a goldsmith, was one of the people who repaired Jerusalem's wall.

H5857G.name: Ai
H5857G.brief: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua after initial defeat.
H5857G.short: Ai, a Canaanite city near Bethel, captured by Israel under Joshua.

H5857H.name: Ai
H5857H.brief: An Ammonite city, to be destroyed by Babylon.
H5857H.short: Ai, an Ammonite city, mentioned in a prophecy against the Ammonites.

H5871H.name: Ain
H5871H.brief: A city in Judah, allotted to the Levites.
H5871H.short: Ain or En-rimmon, a city in Judah's Negev region, given to the Levites.

H5871G.name: Ain
H5871G.brief: A place on the eastern boundary of the Promised Land.
H5871G.short: Ain or Rimmon, a location marking the eastern border of Israel's territory.

H5852H.name: Ataroth
H5852H.brief: A town on the border of Ephraim and Manasseh.
H5852H.short: Ataroth, a town on the border between the territories of Ephraim and Manasseh.

H5852G.name: Ataroth
H5852G.brief: Town in Gilead allotted to Gad
H5852G.short: Ataroth was a town in the region of Gilead allotted to the tribe of Gad.

H5853.name: Ataroth-addar
H5853.brief: A town on the border of Ephraim and Benjamin.
H5853.short: Ataroth-addar, a border town between the territories of Ephraim and Benjamin.

H5854.name: Atroth-beth-joab
H5854.brief: Town associated with Joab from the tribe of Judah.
H5854.short: Atroth-beth-joab was a town linked to Joab in Judah. (<ref="1Ch.2.54">1Ch.2.54</ref>)

H5855.name: Atroth-shophan
H5855.brief: Town allotted to the tribe of Gad.
H5855.short: Atroth-shophan was a town given to the tribe of Gad. (<ref="Numbers 32:35">Numbers 32:35</ref>)

H5825.name: Azekah
H5825.brief: Judean town, site of battles and sieges.
H5825.short: Azekah, a Judean town, was the site of several battles and sieges.

H5898.name: City of Salt
H5898.brief: Town in the wilderness of Judah
H5898.short: The City of Salt was a town located in the wilderness of Judah, near the Dead Sea.

H5858C.name: Ebal Mount
H5858C.brief: A mountain in Canaan, site of curses and blessings ceremony.
H5858C.short: Mount Ebal, also known as Mount Zalmon or Mount Ephraim, was a mountain in Canaan where the Israelites held a ceremony of curses and blessings (<ref="Deu.11.29; 27:4, 13; Joshua 8:30, 33; Judges 9:48; Psalm 68:14; Jeremiah 4:15">Deu.11.29; 27:4, 13; Joshua 8:30, 33; Judges 9:48; Psalm 68:14; Jeremiah 4:15</ref>).

forms.meaning: “double ash-heap: I shall be doubly fruitful”

H5867A.name: Elam
H5867A.brief: Ancient kingdom east of Babylon; ally and enemy of Israel
H5867A.short: Elam, an ancient nation east of Babylon, at times an ally and at times an enemy of Israel.

H5879G.name: Enaim
H5879G.brief: Enaim, place where Tamar posed as a prostitute
H5879G.short: Enaim, the place where Tamar sat and posed as a prostitute to deceive Judah.

H5879H.name: Enam
H5879H.brief: Enam, town allotted to Judah in the Shephelah
H5879H.short: Enam, a town in the Shephelah region, allotted to the tribe of Judah.

H5874.name: En-dor
H5874.brief: Canaanite city; site of Saul's consultation with medium
H5874.short: En-dor, a Canaanite city where Saul consulted a medium before his final battle with the Philistines.

H5882.name: Eneglaim
H5882.brief: Place mentioned in Ezekiel's vision of restored Israel
H5882.short: Eneglaim, a place mentioned in Ezekiel's vision of the restored land of Israel.

H5873G.name: En-gannim
H5873G.brief: City in the lowlands of Judah
H5873G.short: En-gannim, a city in the lowlands of Judah, mentioned in the list of cities allotted to Judah.

H5873H.name: En-gannim
H5873H.short: En-gannim (or Anem), a Levitical city in the territory of Issachar, given to the Gershonite Levites.

H5872.name: Engedi
H5872.brief: Oasis in Judah; refuge for David; Chedorlaomer's victory
H5872.short: Engedi (or Hazazon-tamar), an oasis in Judah where David sought refuge from Saul, also the site of Chedorlaomer's victory.

H5876.name: En-haddah
H5876.brief: City allotted to the tribe of Issachar
H5876.short: En-haddah, a city allotted to the tribe of Issachar during the division of the Promised Land.

H5875.name: En-hakkore
H5875.brief: Spring that appeared after Samson's victory over the Philistines
H5875.short: En-hakkore, the spring that God provided for Samson after his victory over the Philistines at Lehi.

H5877.name: En-hazor
H5877.brief: City allotted to the tribe of Naphtali
H5877.short: En-hazor, a city allotted to the tribe of Naphtali during the division of the Promised Land.

H5883.name: En-rogel
H5883.brief: Spring near Jerusalem; associated with Adonijah's and David's kingships
H5883.short: En-rogel, a spring near Jerusalem, was the site of Adonijah's attempt to become king and later served as a meeting place for David's supporters.

H5885.name: En-shemesh
H5885.brief: Spring on the border between Judah and Benjamin
H5885.short: En-shemesh, a spring on the border between the territories of Judah and Benjamin, near Jerusalem.

H5891J.name: Ephah
H5891J.brief: Arabian tribe; known for their camels and dromedaries
H5891J.short: Ephah, an Arabian tribe known for their camels and dromedaries, mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy of nations coming to Jerusalem.

H5862H.name: Etam
H5862H.brief: Villages associated with Simeon; home of Judahite clan
H5862H.short: Etam, a village associated with the tribe of Simeon and the home of a Judahite clan.

H5862I.name: Etam
H5862I.brief: City fortified by Rehoboam in Judah
H5862I.short: Etam, a city in Judah fortified by King Rehoboam after the division of the kingdom.

H5862G.name: Etam
H5862G.brief: Cliff where Samson hid after defeating the Philistines
H5862G.short: Etam, the cliff where Samson hid after defeating the Philistines, located in Judah.

H5869B.name: Fountain Gate
H5869B.brief: Gate in Jerusalem's wall; rebuilt by Shallun during Nehemiah's time
H5869B.short: The Fountain Gate, a gate in Jerusalem's wall, was rebuilt by Shallun during Nehemiah's time and was a location for processions and gatherings.

H5804.name: Gaza
H5804.brief: Philistine city; Samson's exploits; Philip's ministry
H5804.short: Gaza, one of the five major Philistine cities, was the site of Samson's exploits and a place visited by Philip the evangelist in the early church.

H5878.name: Harod
H5878.brief: A spring near where Gideon gathered his army.
H5878.short: Harod was a spring near the hill of Moreh, where Gideon gathered his army before battling the Midianites (<ref="Judges 7:1">Judges 7:1</ref>).

H5864H.name: Iim
H5864H.brief: A town in the Negev of Judah
H5864H.short: Iim, a town in the Negev region of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:29">Joshua 15:29</ref>).

H5859.name: Ijon
H5859.brief: A town in northern Israel conquered by Assyria
H5859.short: Ijon (Jaan), a town in northern Israel conquered by the Assyrians.

H5863.name: Iye-abarim
H5863.short: Iye-abarim, an Israelite campsite on the border of Moab (<ref="Numbers 21:11; 33:44">Numbers 21:11; 33:44</ref>).

H5864G.name: Iyim
H5864G.brief: An Israelite campsite in the wilderness
H5864G.short: Iyim, an Israelite campsite during the wilderness journey (<ref="Numbers 33:45">Numbers 33:45</ref>).
